newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn basis steady, soy slips.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn basis steady, soy slips.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf corn basis values steadied on Wednesday while soybean offers fell as dealers await Thursday's weekly export data, U.S. export sources said.
"We expect to see a pretty good export sales figure Thursday morning, mostly corn," a U.S. exporter said.

Trade estimates for the U.S. Department of Agriculture's weekly net export sales for the week ended January 30 ranged from 500,000 to 800,000 tonnes for corn and 300,000 to 500,000 tonnes for soybeans were.
Soft red winter wheat and hard red winter wheat values were flat.
